svg.title: When a document counts as missing
svg.desc: Every run reads all pages of the documents and of the trash of Paperless. When a page came back short or empty, or the list changed during the scan, the run reports SCAN INCOMPLETE and counts no document as missing. Otherwise, a document in one of the lists starts its count anew. For a document in neither list, the run asks Paperless for it alone: when Paperless still has it, its count starts anew; an error counts nothing in this run; when Paperless answers 404, it counts one more missing scan, and after N scans in a row its copy moves to the deleted folder, or is deleted when that is allowed, within the batch size.
